title: Zipper Archive Test Fixture Expectation File
description: Schema for the atc-<64hex>.json file paired with each Archive Test Fixture. Contract: docs/archive-test-suites.md (planned, tracked in #834). Semantic equalities that draft-07 cannot express (archive.fileName == fixtureId + ".zip", unique entry ordinals) are verified by src/Zipper.Tests/ArchiveTests/.

generatorContractVersion.description: Contract version of the fixture generator; part of the Fixture ID descriptor.

generatorVersion.description: Version of the generator build that produced the fixture. Informational; not part of the Fixture ID.

fixtureId.description: Unique instance identifier: atc- plus 64 lowercase SHA-256 hex characters over the canonical descriptor (docs/archive-test-suites.md).

caseKey.description: Human-readable scenario name (e.g. valid-empty). Identifies the scenario, not the instance.

classification.description: valid: well-formed. malformed: corrupt structure. policy-sensitive: well-formed bytes whose extraction outcome depends on extractor policy.

fileName.description: Output basename; semantically must equal fixtureId + ".zip".

physicalSize.description: Physical byte size of the published Archive.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the final Archive bytes; part of the Fixture ID descriptor.

entries.description: Archive entries keyed by ordinal. Duplicate entry names are representable; duplicate ordinals are rejected semantically.

localNameRaw.description: Raw local-header name bytes, lowercase hex (empty string allowed for a name-less record).

centralNameRaw.description: Raw central-header name bytes, lowercase hex.

readableName.description: Best-effort readable rendering of the name; lossless bytes live in the raw fields.

contentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the entry payload when knowable (known-content cases).

contentSize.description: Uncompressed payload byte size when knowable.

localHeaderOffset.description: Offset of the local header within the pre-mutation Archive.

dataOffset.description: Offset of the entry payload within the pre-mutation Archive.

centralDirectoryOffset.description: Offset of the central-header record within the pre-mutation Archive.

mutations.description: Ordered mutations applied to the pre-mutation Archive. All offsets and lengths use the before-mutation basis.

beforeHex.description: Inline before-mutation bytes, capped at 256 bytes (512 hex characters). Larger ranges are referenced by hash.

afterHex.description: Inline after-mutation bytes, capped at 256 bytes (512 hex characters).

declaredValue.description: Adversarial declared size (e.g. an oversized declared uncompressed size) as a decimal string or raw hex. Never a trusted JSON integer; expansion budgets are declared separately in limits.

explanation.description: Human-readable description of the injected defect.

expectations.description: Per-operation expected outcomes for named reader profiles. unsupported and not-run are not passing verifications.

platform.description: Applicable platform, when the outcome is platform-dependent.

allowedOutcomes.description: Outcomes that count as passing (e.g. empty-list, full-extract, header-crc-rejected).

failureStages.description: Stages at which failure is allowed to be reported (e.g. open, list, per-entry).

invariants.description: Invariants that must hold for any passing outcome (e.g. no-partial-writes, entry-count-matches).

entryCount.description: Actual entry count in this fixture (budget: 1,000).

expandedBytesBudget.description: Declared expansion budget for this fixture (budget: 32 MiB), independent of adversarial declared sizes.
